title: Multiple vulnerabilities in IBM watsonx Orchestrate with watsonx Assistant Cartridge
description: Multiple vulnerabilities were addressed in IBM watsonx Orchestrate with watsonx Assistant Cartridge version 5.4.0
affected: ibm:IBM watsonx Orchestrate with watsonx Assistant Cartridge

affected_products.product: IBM watsonx Orchestrate with watsonx Assistant Cartridge

cves.title: CVE-2015-8855
cves.description: A vulnerability, which was classified as problematic, was found in PyTorch 2.6.0. Affected is the function torch.nn.functional.ctc_loss of the file aten or src or ATen or native or LossCTC.cpp. The manipulation leads to denial of service. An attack has to be approached locally. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The real existence of this vulnerability is still doubted at the moment. The name of the patch is 46fc5d8e360127361211cb237d5f9eef0223e567. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue. The security policy of the project warns to use unknown models which might establish malicious effects
